p: Represents an operation that applies or restores clipping to the provided canvas. Allows specifying a shape to clip to or restoring the previous canvas state.

pre.code: public void Execute(Gui gui, LayoutNode node, SKCanvas canvas)

p: Executes the clip operation on the provided canvas, applying clipping to the specified node's bounds or restoring the canvas state if required.

ul.li: gui (Gui): The GUI instance managing the current state and operations.
node (LayoutNode): The layout node to which the clip operation is applied.
canvas (SKCanvas): The canvas on which the clip operation is performed.
